text:
olivia_cs: Quick heads-up — Halcyon preview cohort seats opened today. I need confirmations for who will join the onboarding sessions next week. @mike_csm can you pull the enrollment list? :wave:

mike_csm: Got it, pulling now. do we have a hard cap? :thinking:

olivia_cs: initial cap 20 seats, but we can stretch to 25 if needed. priority to existing trial accounts and integration partners.

tara_onboard: Can we split into two 45m sessions (EMEA/APAC + NAM)? I can host Tue/Thu next week. Prefer Tue 09:30 PT, Thu 16:00 PT. :calendar:

mike_csm: leaning toward Tue 09:30 PT for most. i'll send a Doodle and ping folks. sending tentative invites.

dev-bot: Enrollment roster updated: 12 confirmed, 5 pending, 3 waitlisted. Link: https://redwood.internal/roster/halcyon

jordan_product: FYI — release note for halcyon: 'structured-output v1' behind flag. recommend we include a quick demo slide. https://docs.redwood.ai/release/halcyon

sachin_support: FYI there's a known issue with streaming timeouts on older SDK (<=1.3.2). Mitigation: ask customers to upgrade to 1.4.0 or use `?stream=false` for critical flows. Example:
``
client.generate(..., stream=False)
```

olivia_cs: Good catch. we'll add that to the invite & pre-reqs. mike, can you include upgrade note in outreach?

mike_csm: yep — i'll update templates and push invites this afternoon. cc @tara_onboard for session docs.

tara_onboard: I'll prepare slide deck + quick-setup guide. Will post to the cohort channel when ready.

olivia_cs: Thanks all. Can we reconvene Fri morning if roster + slides aren't in place? 10:00 PT?

mike_csm: works for me.

sachin_support: available.

jordan_product: +1

olivia_cs: Great — closing the loop. :thumbsup:
